Sam R (Finance): Partner CloudAxis called out an unexpected line-item split on the June Azure marketplace invoice; they see the same meter billed under two SKUs after our June 1 SKU consolidation. They estimate $11,520 extra.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Please paste partner sample lines so I can validate against our settlement export.

Ana V (Sales): Partner CSV snippet: 
```
inv_line,sku,meter_id,usage,charge
AZ-6201,L-900,73001,40000,5760.00
AZ-6201,L-901,73001,40000,5760.00
```
They flagged meter 73001 duplicated across `L-900` and `L-901`.

BillingBot: Azure payout for CloudAxis (partner_id CA-19) scheduled 2026-06-20T16:00:00Z, status pending.

Liam B (Billing Ops): If payout not processed we can adjust prior to settlement. Recommend: 1) ask partner for signed acceptance of correction, 2) apply manual credit $11,520 memo AZ-MP-2026-06-DEDUPE, 3) update GL 4205-REV-CR. Priya approve?

Priya R (Head of Revenue): Approve up to $12k pending legal language and partner sign-off. Ensure we capture acceptance in contract system.

Sam R (Finance): Noted. Ana, can you send the amendment and request signature today? Also please add a rollout checklist item to verify SKU consolidation propagation to marketplace/reseller paths.

Ana V (Sales): Sent amendment at 2026-06-18T09:10Z. Partner signed and uploaded at 2026-06-18T12:05Z.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Posting credit now and reducing scheduled payout by $11,520. Journal memo AZ-MP-2026-06-DEDUPE. BillingBot, apply temporary hold then release after posting.

BillingBot: Hold applied and payout updated after posting. No further actions pending.

Sam R (Finance): Adjustment confirmed in ledger. Closing ticket. We'll run a short post-mortem with EngOps to add an automated diff check for SKU consolidation rollouts.

Ana V (Sales): Partner thanked us and requested the post-mortem notes. Loop closed. :white_check_mark:
